title: GTA6 Extended Trailer Highlights IGN's Weekly Roundup
description: Check out IGN's weekly trailer roundup featuring an extended look at GTA6, gamescom footage, a new Pokémon stop-motion series, and more.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Extended Trailer Leads IGN's Weekly Entertainment and Gaming Roundup

The entertainment and gaming industries delivered a packed week of promotional content, culminating in a fresh batch of trailers covered by IGN. The media outlet's weekly roundup highlighted 12 trailers spanning video games, movies, and television shows, with an extended look at Grand Theft Auto 6 stealing much of the spotlight.

### GTA6 Extended Footage Dominates the Week

At the center of this week's trailer bounty was the extended look at GTA6. As one of the most anticipated titles in gaming history, any new visual material from Rockstar Games instantly captures the industry's attention. The extended footage provided fans with another glimpse into the highly-anticipated title, keeping community excitement at an all-time high.

### Gamescom Highlights and Pop Culture Trailers

Beyond the GTA6 showcase, the weekly list featured a diverse array of major announcements:

*   **Gamescom Footage**: Tons of new gameplay and promotional footage poured out of gamescom, offering gamers a comprehensive look at upcoming releases.
*   **Film and Television**: Disney+ gave audiences a first look at its upcoming Pokémon stop-motion series, introducing a fresh artistic style to the beloved franchise. Additionally, a new Ali G movie trailer debuted, bringing back the iconic comedy character.

### Editor's Take

It is always fascinating to see how a single extended trailer for GTA6 can completely overshadow a busy week of media drops. While gamescom provided plenty of volume, Rockstar's ongoing rollout continues to command the room. We look forward to seeing how these titles develop as their respective release windows approach.
